title: gh-repo-config
description: Declarative GitHub repository settings. Each section is the request body of one GitHub REST API endpoint. Sections left out are not touched by push or sync.

default_branch.description: Push refuses to change this unless --allow-default-branch-change is given.

branch_protection.description: Branch name to the body of PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection. Unavailable on private repos on a free plan. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/branches/branch-protection#update-branch-protection

rulesets.description: Bodies of POST/PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets, matched by name. Unavailable on private repos on a free plan. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules#update-a-repository-ruleset

environments.description: Environment name to the body of PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{name}. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/environments#create-or-update-an-environment

workflow.description: Body of PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow. can_approve_pull_request_reviews is the 'allow Actions to create and approve pull requests' setting.

vulnerability_alerts.description: true calls PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/vulnerability-alerts, false calls DELETE. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#enable-vulnerability-alerts

^x-comment-.description: A free-text note about the section it is named after. Never sent to the API; pull keeps it.
